note: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after five searches for this part, and most county and city sites did not resolve or could not be found without search, so the constables, magistrates, coroner, jailer, sheriff, county clerks and most city and school board candidates are left blank. Party pages that only list a candidate (the Republican Party of Kentucky for Steven Jack Rudy and Jason Griffith, the Jefferson County Republican Party for Alex Feria) are already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json and are not recorded here as endorsements. Jason Griffith of Lexington (Toyota, District 77) is not shown to be the Jason Griffith of Whitesburg who ran in the 2019 Democratic primary for Secretary of State: no source ties the two by two anchors, so that run is left out. rudyforky.com is a parked domain (it redirects to a lander), not a campaign site. Louisville Metro Council is printed without party on the 2026 ballots and its May 2026 primary was a single nonpartisan contest per district (Jefferson County Clerk's official statement of votes cast), so 'Nonpartisan office' in our record agrees with the source.
